WITH ef AS ( SELECT f.*, CASE WHEN f.subject_id = #{entityId} THEN 'out' ELSE 'in' END AS direction, CASE WHEN f.subject_id = #{entityId} THEN f.object_id ELSE f.subject_id END AS other_id FROM facts f WHERE f.kb_id = #{kbId} AND (f.subject_id = #{entityId} OR f.object_id = #{entityId}) ), ev AS ( SELECT ef.*, ef.recorded_at AS at, CASE WHEN ef.supersedes IS NULL THEN 'asserted' ELSE 'corrected' END AS kind FROM ef UNION ALL
SELECT ef.*, ef.invalidated_at AS at, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_adoptions fa WHERE fa.old_fact_id = ef.id AND fa.mode = 'merged' AND fa.reverted_at IS NULL) THEN 'merged' ELSE 'rejected' END AS kind FROM ef WHERE ef.invalidated_at IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM facts s WHERE s.supersedes = ef.id) ),
rt AS ( SELECT r.created_at AS at, 'retyped' AS kind, r.actor_id, tf.label AS from_type_label, tt.label AS to_type_label FROM entity_retypes r LEFT JOIN entity_types tf ON tf.id = r.from_type_id JOIN entity_types tt ON tt.id = r.to_type_id WHERE r.kb_id = #{kbId} AND r.entity_id = #{entityId} UNION ALL SELECT r.reverted_at, 'retype_reverted', r.actor_id, tf.label, tt.label FROM entity_retypes r LEFT JOIN entity_types tf ON tf.id = r.from_type_id JOIN entity_types tt ON tt.id = r.to_type_id WHERE r.kb_id = #{kbId} AND r.entity_id = #{entityId} AND r.reverted_at IS NOT NULL ), /* 合并也是这个实体身上的一次认识改变，而且是最大的一次：从此它和另一个 实体算同一个东西。两个方向分开记：merged_in = 别人并进了它（事实搬到它名下）， merged_away = 它并进了别人。同一句话说两件事会让「谁吸收了谁」读不出来， 而回滚正是按方向做的 */ mg AS ( SELECT m.created_at AS at, CASE WHEN m.target_id = #{entityId} THEN 'merged_in' ELSE 'merged_away' END AS kind, m.merged_by AS actor_id, CASE WHEN m.target_id = #{entityId} THEN m.source_id ELSE m.target_id END AS other_id FROM entity_merges m WHERE m.kb_id = #{kbId} AND (m.source_id = #{entityId} OR m.target_id = #{entityId}) UNION ALL
SELECT m.reverted_at, 'merge_reverted', (SELECT a.actor_id FROM audit_events a WHERE a.kb_id = #{kbId} AND a.action = 'merge.revert' AND a.target_id = m.id ORDER BY a.created_at DESC LIMIT 1), CASE WHEN m.target_id = #{entityId} THEN m.source_id ELSE m.target_id END FROM entity_merges m WHERE m.kb_id = #{kbId} AND (m.source_id = #{entityId} OR m.target_id = #{entityId}) AND m.reverted_at IS NOT NULL )
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM ev) + (SELECT count(*) FROM rt) + (SELECT count(*) FROM mg)

SELECT e.id, e.canonical_name AS name, t.key AS type_key, t.label AS type_label, coalesce(t.color, '#94a3b8') AS color, coalesce(t.shape, 'circle') AS shape, e.disambiguator, (SELECT count(*) FROM facts f WHERE f.kb_id = e.kb_id AND (f.subject_id = e.id OR f.object_id = e.id) AND f.invalidated_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM relation_types nr WHERE nr.id = f.predicate_id AND nr.builtin AND nr.key = 'known_as')) AS degree FROM entities e LEFT JOIN entity_types t ON t.id = e.type_id WHERE e.kb_id = #{kbId} AND e.id = #{entityId}

SELECT e.id, e.canonical_name AS name, t.key AS type_key, t.label AS type_label, coalesce(t.color, '#94a3b8') AS color, coalesce(t.shape, 'circle') AS shape, e.disambiguator, (SELECT count(*) FROM facts f WHERE f.kb_id = e.kb_id AND (fact_owner_at(f.id, f.subject_id, #{asOf}, false) = e.id OR fact_owner_at(f.id, f.object_id, #{asOf}, true) = e.id) AND f.recorded_at <= coalesce(#{asOf}, now()) AND (f.invalidated_at IS NULL OR f.invalidated_at > coalesce(#{asOf}, now())) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM relation_types nr WHERE nr.id = f.predicate_id AND nr.builtin AND nr.key = 'known_as')) AS degree FROM entities e LEFT JOIN entity_types t ON t.id = e.type_id WHERE e.kb_id = #{kbId} AND e.id = #{entityId}

SELECT e.id, e.canonical_name AS name, t.key AS type_key, t.label AS type_label, coalesce(t.color, '#94a3b8') AS color, coalesce(t.shape, 'circle') AS shape, e.disambiguator, (SELECT count(*) FROM facts f WHERE f.kb_id = e.kb_id AND (f.subject_id = e.id OR f.object_id = e.id) AND f.invalidated_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM relation_types nr WHERE nr.id = f.predicate_id AND nr.builtin AND nr.key = 'known_as')) AS degree FROM entities e LEFT JOIN entity_types t ON t.id = e.type_id WHERE e.kb_id = #{kbId} AND e.merged_into IS NULL AND e.id <> #{entityId} AND lower(e.canonical_name) = (SELECT lower(canonical_name) FROM entities WHERE id = #{entityId}) ORDER BY degree DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT e.id, e.canonical_name AS name, t.key AS type_key, t.label AS type_label, coalesce(t.color, '#94a3b8') AS color, coalesce(t.shape, 'circle') AS shape, e.disambiguator, (SELECT count(*) FROM facts f WHERE f.kb_id = e.kb_id AND (fact_owner_at(f.id, f.subject_id, #{asOf}, false) = e.id OR fact_owner_at(f.id, f.object_id, #{asOf}, true) = e.id) AND f.recorded_at <= coalesce(#{asOf}, now()) AND (f.invalidated_at IS NULL OR f.invalidated_at > coalesce(#{asOf}, now())) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM relation_types nr WHERE nr.id = f.predicate_id AND nr.builtin AND nr.key = 'known_as')) AS degree FROM entities e LEFT JOIN entity_types t ON t.id = e.type_id WHERE e.kb_id = #{kbId} AND e.created_at <= coalesce(#{asOf}, now()) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM entity_merges m WHERE m.source_id = e.id AND m.created_at <= coalesce(#{asOf}, now()) AND (m.reverted_at IS NULL OR m.reverted_at > coalesce(#{asOf}, now()))) AND e.id <> #{entityId} AND lower(e.canonical_name) = (SELECT lower(canonical_name) FROM entities WHERE id = #{entityId}) ORDER BY degree DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT f.id, f.subject_id AS subject_id, f.object_id AS object_id FROM facts f WHERE f.kb_id = #{kbId} AND f.object_id IS NOT NULL AND (f.subject_id = ANY(#{ids,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler}::uuid[]) OR f.object_id = ANY(#{ids,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler}::uuid[])) AND f.subject_id <> f.object_id AND f.invalidated_at IS NULL AND (#{at}::timestamptz IS NULL OR (NOT ( (SELECT r2.temporal FROM relation_types r2 WHERE r2.id = f.predicate_id) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'event' AND f.valid_from IS NULL AND f.attested_from IS NULL) AND ((COALESCE(f.valid_from, f.attested_from) IS NULL OR COALESCE(f.valid_from, f.attested_from) <= #{at}::timestamptz) AND (CASE WHEN f.valid_to IS NOT NULL THEN f.valid_to WHEN f.valid_to_precision = 'unknown' THEN f.attested_to END IS NULL OR CASE WHEN f.valid_to IS NOT NULL THEN f.valid_to WHEN f.valid_to_precision = 'unknown' THEN f.attested_to END > #{at}::timestamptz))))

SELECT f.id, fact_owner_at(f.id, f.subject_id, #{asOf}, false) AS subject_id, fact_owner_at(f.id, f.object_id, #{asOf}, true) AS object_id FROM facts f WHERE f.kb_id = #{kbId} AND f.object_id IS NOT NULL AND (fact_owner_at(f.id, f.subject_id, #{asOf}, false) = ANY(#{ids,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler}::uuid[]) OR fact_owner_at(f.id, f.object_id, #{asOf}, true) = ANY(#{ids,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler}::uuid[])) AND fact_owner_at(f.id, f.subject_id, #{asOf}, false) <> fact_owner_at(f.id, f.object_id, #{asOf}, true) AND f.recorded_at <= coalesce(#{asOf}, now()) AND (f.invalidated_at IS NULL OR f.invalidated_at > coalesce(#{asOf}, now())) AND (#{at}::timestamptz IS NULL OR (NOT ( (SELECT r2.temporal FROM relation_types r2 WHERE r2.id = f.predicate_id) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'event' AND f.valid_from IS NULL AND f.attested_from IS NULL) AND ((COALESCE(f.valid_from, f.attested_from) IS NULL OR COALESCE(f.valid_from, f.attested_from) <= #{at}::timestamptz) AND (CASE WHEN f.valid_to IS NOT NULL THEN f.valid_to WHEN f.valid_to_precision = 'unknown' THEN f.attested_to END IS NULL OR CASE WHEN f.valid_to IS NOT NULL THEN f.valid_to WHEN f.valid_to_precision = 'unknown' THEN f.attested_to END > #{at}::timestamptz))))

SELECT n.id, count(f.id) AS degree FROM unnest(#{ids,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler}::uuid[]) AS n(id) JOIN facts f ON f.kb_id = #{kbId} AND f.object_id IS NOT NULL AND (f.subject_id = n.id OR f.object_id = n.id) AND f.invalidated_at IS NULL AND (#{at}::timestamptz IS NULL OR (NOT ( (SELECT r2.temporal FROM relation_types r2 WHERE r2.id = f.predicate_id) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'event' AND f.valid_from IS NULL AND f.attested_from IS NULL) AND ((COALESCE(f.valid_from, f.attested_from) IS NULL OR COALESCE(f.valid_from, f.attested_from) <= #{at}::timestamptz) AND (CASE WHEN f.valid_to IS NOT NULL THEN f.valid_to WHEN f.valid_to_precision = 'unknown' THEN f.attested_to END IS NULL OR CASE WHEN f.valid_to IS NOT NULL THEN f.valid_to WHEN f.valid_to_precision = 'unknown' THEN f.attested_to END > #{at}::timestamptz)))) GROUP BY n.id

SELECT n.id, count(f.id) AS degree FROM unnest(#{ids,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler}::uuid[]) AS n(id) JOIN facts f ON f.kb_id = #{kbId} AND f.object_id IS NOT NULL AND (fact_owner_at(f.id, f.subject_id, #{asOf}, false) = n.id OR fact_owner_at(f.id, f.object_id, #{asOf}, true) = n.id) AND f.recorded_at <= coalesce(#{asOf}, now()) AND (f.invalidated_at IS NULL OR f.invalidated_at > coalesce(#{asOf}, now())) AND (#{at}::timestamptz IS NULL OR (NOT ( (SELECT r2.temporal FROM relation_types r2 WHERE r2.id = f.predicate_id) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'event' AND f.valid_from IS NULL AND f.attested_from IS NULL) AND ((COALESCE(f.valid_from, f.attested_from) IS NULL OR COALESCE(f.valid_from, f.attested_from) <= #{at}::timestamptz) AND (CASE WHEN f.valid_to IS NOT NULL THEN f.valid_to WHEN f.valid_to_precision = 'unknown' THEN f.attested_to END IS NULL OR CASE WHEN f.valid_to IS NOT NULL THEN f.valid_to WHEN f.valid_to_precision = 'unknown' THEN f.attested_to END > #{at}::timestamptz)))) GROUP BY n.id

WITH time_corrected_targets AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (target_id) target_id, detail->>'note' AS note FROM audit_events WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND action = 'fact.time_corrected' AND target_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY target_id, created_at DESC) SELECT f.id AS fact_id, f.subject_id AS subject_id, s.canonical_name AS subject_name, f.object_id AS object_id, o.canonical_name AS object_name, COALESCE(r.label, fact_surface_predicate(f.id)) AS predicate, f.valid_from, f.valid_from_precision, f.valid_to, f.valid_to_precision, CASE WHEN (SELECT r2.temporal FROM relation_types r2 WHERE r2.id = f.predicate_id) = 'eternal' THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(f.valid_from, f.attested_from) END AS holds_from, CASE WHEN (SELECT r2.temporal FROM relation_types r2 WHERE r2.id = f.predicate_id) = 'eternal' THEN NULL WHEN (SELECT r2.temporal FROM relation_types r2 WHERE r2.id = f.predicate_id) = 'event' THEN CASE WHEN f.valid_from IS NULL THEN f.attested_from ELSE COALESCE(f.valid_to, f.valid_from) + ('1 ' || COALESCE(NULLIF(f.valid_to_precision, 'unknown'), f.valid_from_precision))::interval END WHEN f.valid_to IS NOT NULL THEN f.valid_to WHEN f.valid_to_precision = 'unknown' THEN f.attested_to END AS holds_to, f.confidence, f.end_derived, (CASE WHEN f.end_derived AND f.corrected_ends = 'end' THEN NULL WHEN f.end_derived AND f.corrected_ends = 'both' THEN 'start' ELSE f.corrected_ends END) IS NOT NULL AS time_corrected, (CASE WHEN f.end_derived AND f.corrected_ends = 'end' THEN NULL WHEN f.end_derived AND f.corrected_ends = 'both' THEN 'start' ELSE f.corrected_ends END) AS corrected_ends, closer.closed_by_id, closer.closed_by, closer.closed_by_value, CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN f.end_derived AND f.corrected_ends = 'end' THEN NULL WHEN f.end_derived AND f.corrected_ends = 'both' THEN 'start' ELSE f.corrected_ends END) IS NOT NULL THEN (WITH RECURSIVE chain(id, depth) AS ( SELECT f.supersedes, 1 WHERE f.supersedes IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT p.supersedes, chain.depth + 1 FROM facts p JOIN chain ON p.id = chain.id WHERE p.supersedes IS NOT NULL) SELECT t.note FROM chain JOIN time_corrected_targets t ON t.target_id = chain.id ORDER BY chain.depth LIMIT 1) END AS correction_note FROM facts f LEFT JOIN relation_types r ON r.id = f.predicate_id JOIN entities s ON s.id = f.subject_id JOIN entities o ON o.id = f.object_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT n.id AS closed_by_id, CASE WHEN rn.inverse_functional AND n.object_id = f.object_id THEN n_s.canonical_name ELSE n_o.canonical_name END AS closed_by, CASE WHEN rn.inverse_functional AND n.object_id = f.object_id THEN NULL ELSE n.object_value END AS closed_by_value FROM facts n JOIN relation_types rn ON rn.id = n.predicate_id LEFT JOIN entities n_s ON n_s.id = n.subject_id LEFT JOIN entities n_o ON n_o.id = n.object_id WHERE f.end_derived AND f.valid_to IS NOT NULL AND n.kb_id = f.kb_id AND n.predicate_id = f.predicate_id AND n.id <> f.id AND n.invalidated_at IS NULL AND n.valid_from = f.valid_to AND n.valid_from_grade IS DISTINCT FROM 'C' AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_evidence fe JOIN chunks ch ON ch.id = fe.chunk_id WHERE fe.fact_id = n.id AND ch.origin = 'described') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM typed_fact_sources ts JOIN fact_evidence fe ON fe.fact_id = ts.statement_id JOIN chunks ch ON ch.id = fe.chunk_id WHERE ts.fact_id = n.id AND ch.origin = 'described')) AND ((rn.functional AND n.subject_id = f.subject_id AND (n.object_id IS DISTINCT FROM f.object_id OR n.object_value IS DISTINCT FROM f.object_value)) OR (rn.inverse_functional AND n.object_id = f.object_id AND n.subject_id <> f.subject_id)) ORDER BY n.id LIMIT 1) closer ON true WHERE f.kb_id = #{kbId} AND f.id = ANY(#{ids,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler}::uuid[])

WITH time_corrected_targets AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (target_id) target_id, detail->>'note' AS note FROM audit_events WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND action = 'fact.time_corrected' AND target_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY target_id, created_at DESC) SELECT f.id AS fact_id, fact_owner_at(f.id, f.subject_id, #{asOf}, false) AS subject_id, s.canonical_name AS subject_name, fact_owner_at(f.id, f.object_id, #{asOf}, true) AS object_id, o.canonical_name AS object_name, COALESCE(r.label, fact_surface_predicate(f.id)) AS predicate, f.valid_from, f.valid_from_precision, f.valid_to, f.valid_to_precision, CASE WHEN (SELECT r2.temporal FROM relation_types r2 WHERE r2.id = f.predicate_id) = 'eternal' THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(f.valid_from, f.attested_from) END AS holds_from, CASE WHEN (SELECT r2.temporal FROM relation_types r2 WHERE r2.id = f.predicate_id) = 'eternal' THEN NULL WHEN (SELECT r2.temporal FROM relation_types r2 WHERE r2.id = f.predicate_id) = 'event' THEN CASE WHEN f.valid_from IS NULL THEN f.attested_from ELSE COALESCE(f.valid_to, f.valid_from) + ('1 ' || COALESCE(NULLIF(f.valid_to_precision, 'unknown'), f.valid_from_precision))::interval END WHEN f.valid_to IS NOT NULL THEN f.valid_to WHEN f.valid_to_precision = 'unknown' THEN f.attested_to END AS holds_to, f.confidence, f.end_derived, (CASE WHEN f.end_derived AND f.corrected_ends = 'end' THEN NULL WHEN f.end_derived AND f.corrected_ends = 'both' THEN 'start' ELSE f.corrected_ends END) IS NOT NULL AS time_corrected, (CASE WHEN f.end_derived AND f.corrected_ends = 'end' THEN NULL WHEN f.end_derived AND f.corrected_ends = 'both' THEN 'start' ELSE f.corrected_ends END) AS corrected_ends, closer.closed_by_id, closer.closed_by, closer.closed_by_value, CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN f.end_derived AND f.corrected_ends = 'end' THEN NULL WHEN f.end_derived AND f.corrected_ends = 'both' THEN 'start' ELSE f.corrected_ends END) IS NOT NULL THEN (WITH RECURSIVE chain(id, depth) AS ( SELECT f.supersedes, 1 WHERE f.supersedes IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT p.supersedes, chain.depth + 1 FROM facts p JOIN chain ON p.id = chain.id WHERE p.supersedes IS NOT NULL) SELECT t.note FROM chain JOIN time_corrected_targets t ON t.target_id = chain.id ORDER BY chain.depth LIMIT 1) END AS correction_note FROM facts f LEFT JOIN relation_types r ON r.id = f.predicate_id JOIN entities s ON s.id = fact_owner_at(f.id, f.subject_id, #{asOf}, false) JOIN entities o ON o.id = fact_owner_at(f.id, f.object_id, #{asOf}, true) LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT n.id AS closed_by_id, CASE WHEN rn.inverse_functional AND fact_owner_at(n.id, n.object_id, #{asOf}, true) = fact_owner_at(f.id, f.object_id, #{asOf}, true) THEN n_s.canonical_name ELSE n_o.canonical_name END AS closed_by, CASE WHEN rn.inverse_functional AND fact_owner_at(n.id, n.object_id, #{asOf}, true) = fact_owner_at(f.id, f.object_id, #{asOf}, true) THEN NULL ELSE n.object_value END AS closed_by_value FROM facts n JOIN relation_types rn ON rn.id = n.predicate_id LEFT JOIN entities n_s ON n_s.id = fact_owner_at(n.id, n.subject_id, #{asOf}, false) LEFT JOIN entities n_o ON n_o.id = fact_owner_at(n.id, n.object_id, #{asOf}, true) WHERE f.end_derived AND f.valid_to IS NOT NULL AND n.kb_id = f.kb_id AND n.predicate_id = f.predicate_id AND n.id <> f.id AND n.recorded_at <= coalesce(#{asOf}, now()) AND (n.invalidated_at IS NULL OR n.invalidated_at > coalesce(#{asOf}, now())) AND n.valid_from = f.valid_to AND n.valid_from_grade IS DISTINCT FROM 'C' AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_evidence fe JOIN chunks ch ON ch.id = fe.chunk_id WHERE fe.fact_id = n.id AND ch.origin = 'described') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM typed_fact_sources ts JOIN fact_evidence fe ON fe.fact_id = ts.statement_id JOIN chunks ch ON ch.id = fe.chunk_id WHERE ts.fact_id = n.id AND ch.origin = 'described')) AND ((rn.functional AND fact_owner_at(n.id, n.subject_id, #{asOf}, false) = fact_owner_at(f.id, f.subject_id, #{asOf}, false) AND (fact_owner_at(n.id, n.object_id, #{asOf}, true) IS DISTINCT FROM fact_owner_at(f.id, f.object_id, #{asOf}, true) OR n.object_value IS DISTINCT FROM f.object_value)) OR (rn.inverse_functional AND fact_owner_at(n.id, n.object_id, #{asOf}, true) = fact_owner_at(f.id, f.object_id, #{asOf}, true) AND fact_owner_at(n.id, n.subject_id, #{asOf}, false) <> fact_owner_at(f.id, f.subject_id, #{asOf}, false))) ORDER BY n.id LIMIT 1) closer ON true WHERE f.kb_id = #{kbId} AND f.id = ANY(#{ids,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler}::uuid[])

WITH ev AS ( SELECT f.id, f.subject_id, f.predicate_id, f.object_id, f.object_value, f.valid_from, f.valid_from_precision, f.valid_to, f.valid_to_precision, f.confidence, f.recorded_at AS at, CASE WHEN f.supersedes IS NULL THEN 'asserted' ELSE 'corrected' END AS kind FROM facts f WHERE f.kb_id = #{kbId} AND f.recorded_at >= #{since} AND f.recorded_at < #{until} AND (#{entityId}::uuid IS NULL OR f.subject_id = #{entityId} OR f.object_id = #{entityId}) UNION ALL SELECT f.id, f.subject_id, f.predicate_id, f.object_id, f.object_value, f.valid_from, f.valid_from_precision, f.valid_to, f.valid_to_precision, f.confidence, f.invalidated_at AS at, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_adoptions fa WHERE fa.old_fact_id = f.id AND fa.mode = 'merged' AND fa.reverted_at IS NULL) THEN 'merged' ELSE 'rejected' END AS kind FROM facts f WHERE f.kb_id = #{kbId} AND f.invalidated_at >= #{since} AND f.invalidated_at < #{until} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM facts s WHERE s.supersedes = f.id) AND (#{entityId}::uuid IS NULL OR f.subject_id = #{entityId} OR f.object_id = #{entityId}) ) SELECT ev.id AS fact_id, ev.at, ev.kind, ev.subject_id, s.canonical_name AS subject_name, COALESCE(r.label, fact_surface_predicate(ev.id)) AS predicate_label, o.canonical_name AS object_name, ev.object_value, ev.valid_from, ev.valid_from_precision, ev.valid_to, ev.valid_to_precision, ev.confidence, src.document_id, src.filename, src.quote FROM ev LEFT JOIN relation_types r ON r.id = ev.predicate_id JOIN entities s ON s.id = ev.subject_id LEFT JOIN entities o ON o.id = ev.object_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT d.id AS document_id, d.filename, fe.quote FROM fact_evidence fe JOIN chunks c ON c.id = fe.chunk_id JOIN documents d ON d.id = c.document_id WHERE fe.fact_id = ev.id ORDER BY fe.doc_version DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1 ) src ON true WHERE (#{kinds}::text[] IS NULL OR ev.kind = ANY(#{kinds}))
AND NOT (coalesce(r.builtin AND r.key = 'known_as', false) AND lower(ev.object_value->>'value') = lower(s.canonical_name)) ORDER BY ev.at DESC, ev.id LIMIT #{limit}
